title: Massive GTA 6 Banner In Paris Censors All Of The Guns
summary: Grand Theft Auto is a franchise that famously includes guns, but this big advertisement for it in Paris cut them out
text: Massive GTA 6 Banner In Paris Censors All Of The Guns Skip to content Kotaku Latest Entertainment Reviews News Tips & Guides Games Downloads Deals News Massive GTA 6 Banner In Paris Censors All Of The Guns Grand Theft Auto is a franchise that famously includes guns, but this big advertisement for it in Paris cut them out Grand Theft Auto 6 GTA 6 Rockstar Games By Zack Zwiezen Published October 15, 2026 | Comments ( 1 ) | 𝕏 Copied! © Rockstar Games / Théodore / Rockstar Mags / Kotaku Grand Theft Auto 6 is just weeks away from launching on PS5 and Xbox. As we get closer to that November 19 launch date, Rockstar’s marketing is kicking into full gear, including a new trailer, multiple cover stories, and merchandise. It also means there are murals and banners popping up around the globe. Though in Paris, you might notice some guns missing from one massive GTA 6 banner. Over the last two weeks, people online have been documenting the progress on a massive banner advertisement for Grand Theft Auto 6 being attached to one of the Les Mercuriales towers in Paris, France. And on Thursday , it was reported that work had wrapped up on the big banner, which recreates the GTA 6 cover art on the side of the building. However, as pointed out by some fans, this artwork has been tweaked slightly to remove two different guns . © Rockstar Games / Reddit / Kotaku As you can see in the comparison above, Lucia’s gun has been removed from the top middle image of her and Jason. Meanwhile, an assault rifle has been removed from the bottom middle image of the official cover art as well. In Lucia’s case, her hand and the gun were removed. In the other example, it seems the artwork has been tweaked to just have the character’s hand in the air with no gun in front of it. Other banners and murals that have gone up in the United States, like this one in NYC, have artwork featuring guns. A perspective I hadn't seen of the GTA mural shows how close it is to the NYC skyline by u/GameDrain in GTA6 But apparently over in Paris, the people who own this tower aren’t too keen on having giant guns slapped on the side of the building. Though they’re more than fine taking the cash to advertise a game with guns in it. Or maybe there are some advertising restrictions on guns in Paris that I’m not aware of. Either way, it’s all a bit silly. 🕹️ Level up your inbox Don’t miss the latest reviews, news and tips. Sign up for our free newsletter.
